calibration.prompt.capture_instructions: {prefix}{msg} Press CAPTURE (or SPACE): I count 3, 2, 1 and you hold still until the final beep.
calibration.speech.calibrate_first: First, calibrate the camera. I'll ask you to look in a few directions.
calibration.speech.calibrated_test: Calibrated! Now TEST it: look at the screen, to the sides and down, and check that I get it right.
calibration.speech.camera_on: Camera's on. If you pick up your phone mid-work, I'll see it.
calibration.speech.camera_starting: The camera is still starting up... hold on a moment.
calibration.speech.face_not_seen: I couldn't see your face properly! Stay visible to the camera.
calibration.speech.face_vanishes_when_do: Your face disappears when you look down. No problem: a face vanishing right after you lower your head will count as phone use.
calibration.speech.pitch_too_small: I barely saw a difference! Lower your head more, for real.
calibration.speech.test_now: Now TEST it: look at the screen, to the sides and down.
calibration.speech.yaw_too_small: You barely turned your face! Turn your head to the monitor, not just your eyes.
calibration.step.look_down: Look DOWN, as if checking your phone on the desk or in your lap.
calibration.step.main_screen: Look at the MAIN SCREEN (the one with the camera), in your normal working posture.
calibration.step.side_monitor: Turn your face to the monitor on the {side} ({n}).
calibration.test.combat_rules: In combat: warning after ~2s and infraction after {tol}s looking away. Adjust the tolerance in SETTINGS.
calibration.test.instructions: Move your head and see what the General sees. If he gets it wrong a lot, click REDO.
calibration.test.title: SURVEILLANCE TEST

speech.blocking.closed_apps: Closed {apps}. You can open it later.
speech.blocking.pass_expired: Time's up! {groups} blocked again. Back to work!
speech.break.ended: Break's over. Sites are blocked again.
speech.break.idle_remarks: At ease! Go watch your videos.
Drink some water. Stretch your legs.
Breaks go fast. Don't get lost on YouTube.
speech.break.skipped: Volunteering to return early? That's my soldier!
speech.camera.absent: Where'd you go? Walked off in the middle of work?
speech.camera.back_at_post: Back at your post. Don't let it happen again.
speech.camera.scold_looking_away: You've been staring off to the side for ages.
You drifted off the screen again.
speech.camera.scold_looking_down: EYES ON THE SCREEN! Caught you on your phone.
speech.camera.warn_looking_away: Where are you looking? There's no monitor there!
Find something interesting on the wall?
speech.camera.warn_looking_down: Is that a phone in your hand?
Head up. The work is on the screen.
speech.desertion.approved_default: Dismissed. Come back when you can.
speech.desertion.denied_default: Desertion DENIED! Back to your post!
speech.desertion.resume_hint: When you want to come back, just hit RESUME.
speech.greeting.first_time: Report in, soldier! I'm the General. Give me your tasks and I'll handle the distractions.
speech.greeting.mission_done: Mission accomplished! Rest up, soldier. Set the next one whenever you're ready.
speech.greeting.resume_work: Resuming the mission. Thought closing the app would save you? The sites are still blocked!
speech.greeting.still_on_break: Still on break. Enjoy it, soldier.
speech.greeting.unfinished_mission: You left {n} task(s) unfinished. Pick up where you left off, or start something new?
speech.idle.prompt_remarks: What are we doing today? Write down the tasks.
Without a task list you'll end up on YouTube. I know you.
speech.install.confirm_password: Confirm the administrator password in the system dialog.
speech.mission.cannot_remove_task: You don't erase mission tasks mid-combat, soldier!
speech.mission.cleared: Clean slate. What are the tasks for the new mission?
speech.mission.discard_confirm: That throws away your {n} pending tasks. Click again to confirm.
speech.mission.list_tasks: List the mission's tasks. The sites stay blocked until ALL of them are done!
speech.mission.resumed: Back at it. {n} tasks to go, and the sites are blocked again.{warn}
speech.mission.started: Here we go! {n} minutes of work, and the sites that distract you are already blocked.{warn}
speech.mission.task_added: More work? That's what I like to hear!
speech.mission.type_task_first: Type the task in the field first, soldier.
speech.mission.victory: Mission accomplished! Everything's unblocked. Go rest, you earned it.
speech.quit.denied: NOBODY ABANDONS THEIR POST! (The block stays on even if you kill me.)
speech.request.asking_command: Hmm... let me check this with high command.
speech.request.justification_too_short: That's no justification! Explain yourself properly.
speech.request.no_ai_wait: No radio to high command. So let's test your patience: {n} seconds staring at your work. If you still want it after that, we'll talk.
speech.request.opened: Talk. What do you want to open, and what for?
speech.request.recently_denied: Request denied recently. Try again in {time}.
speech.request.still_denied: I said NO. Next request in {time}.
speech.settings.blocklist_locked: Editing the blocklist mid-combat? Nice try.
speech.settings.config_file_hint: File: {path}. Edit 'bloqueios' and restart the app.
speech.settings.locked_during_work: Changing the timer now? Only on break.
speech.settings.saved_no_ai_suffix: Without AI, access requests cost you a wait.
speech.stage.field_reached: First task done. We're out of HQ.
speech.stage.parade_reached: I can hear the band already. Finish what's left and the parade is yours.
speech.stage.trench_reached: Past the halfway mark. It's the front line from here.
speech.work.glance_back_remarks: Nice day out there. Too bad you've got tasks.
I see everything. Even with my back turned.
speech.work.idle_remarks: Is that new tab actually for work?
No feeds. Finish this task first.
The clock's moving. So should you.
Sit up straight and look at the screen.
I saw you eyeing your phone. Don't.
Finish the next line. Then the one after that.
Stuck? Write down where, and move on to the next part.
speech.work.poke_back_remarks: Poking me? I'm the one who pokes around here.
Clicking me won't finish any tasks.
Is that insubordination? Back to work!
